items.title: Huntington launches small-biz operating platform
items.summary: p ldquo;We have a desire to have the most compelling value proposition for small businesses in the country, rdquo; Huntington President Brant Standridge said of the bank rsquo;s AI-powered 1866 Studio. /p
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Visa secures China card business green light
items.summary: US behemoth Visa has secured approval from the People’s Bank of China to set up a domestic bank card clearing business in the country.
items.why: Visa gains rare approval for domestic Chinese bank card clearing.

items.title: Starling becomes first bank to train AI model on UK sovereign cloud
items.summary: Starling is working with AI chip making giant Nvidia to build a transactional foundational model that is trained and hosted within a UK sovereign cloud.
items.why: First UK bank to train foundational AI model on sovereign cloud.

items.title: EBA classifies USDC as significant e-money token under MiCA
items.summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has classified USDC, issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, as a significant e-money token (EMT) under the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA), following its assessment of the criteria set out in the Regulation.
items.why: EBA classifies major stablecoin as significant under MiCA.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents from directly accessing customer accounts
items.summary: Weeks after the launch of Meta's Muse AI assistant, Jamie Dimon says JPMorgan Chase is not going to allow outside agents to directly access accounts on behalf of retail customers.
items.why: Major US bank sets precedent by banning third-party AI agents from directly accessing customer accounts.

items.title: Spanish banks arrange syndicated finance on blockchain
items.summary: Two Spanish banks, Santander and BBVA, and utility company Iberdrola, are claiming a blockchain first after arranging a syndicated financing facility executed through a blockchain platform
items.why: Major Spanish banks execute first syndicated financing on blockchain.

items.title: Ramp hits $60bn valuation
items.summary: Expense management firm Ramp has closed its second major raise in a matter of months, securing $1.85 billion in a primary financing round led by Dragoneer Investment Group that values the company at $60 billion.
items.why: Massive $60 billion valuation and huge primary funding round for a major fintech.

items.title: Mastercard and BVNK bring fiat and stablecoin payments together in global money platform
items.summary: Mastercard has launched a platform that brings together its global payments capabilities with the stablecoin infrastructure of its recently acquired BVNK unit through a single API.
items.why: Mastercard launching a combined fiat and stablecoin global platform via BVNK.

items.title: SEB pays $33m to NYDFS over AML failures
items.summary: New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) Acting Superintendent Kaitlin Asrow announced today that Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB and its New York Branch (together, SEB or the Bank) have agreed to pay a $33 million penalty as part of a Consent Order to resolve the Department’s investigation into SEB’s compliance with New York Banking Law and anti-money laundering program failures.
items.why: Major enforcement action: $33 million AML penalty from NYDFS against SEB.

items.title: Acorns buys Gen Z social finance app Frich
items.summary: Savings and investment app Acorns has acquired Gen Z-focused social finance app Frich. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
items.why: Acorns acquires Gen Z social finance app Frich in notable fintech deal.

items.title: FCA calls for disclaimers on AI financial advice
items.summary: The UK's financial services watchdog is calling on AI providers to issue disclaimers for services that provide financial advice to consumers via agentic AI.
items.why: FCA initiates new regulatory expectations regarding disclaimers on consumer AI financial advice.

items.title: JP Morgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum
items.summary: JP Morgan has brought its deposit token product, JPM Coin, to the Ethereum layer 1 blockchain network.
items.why: Major Wall Street bank expands flagship deposit token to public permissionless blockchain.

items.title: UK sets out proposal to open up access to iPhone contactless payments
items.summary: The UK's competition watchdog is consulting on proposals to unlock contactless technology on iPhones, making it easier for Apple Pay rivals to flourish by lowering fees and removing technical ​barriers.
items.why: UK regulator proposes formal competition rules opening Apple contactless payments to rivals.

items.title: NAB cuts 2,500 jobs citing technological change
items.summary: National Australia Bank (NAB) is to axe 2,500 employees in its latest restructuring, equivalent to 6% of the workforce
items.why: Major bank restructuring cutting 2,500 jobs citing technological change.

items.title: NatWest orders 30,000 staff to spend more time in the office
items.summary: UK banking giant NatWest has told tens of thousands of employees to spend more time in the office in a move described as a kick in the teeth by union Unite.
items.why: Major UK bank imposes broad return-to-office mandate affecting 30,000 employees.

items.title: Programmable banking platform Hyperlayer raises £19.5m
items.summary: Hyperlayer, the London-based fintech founded by former Morgan Stanley executives to help banks modernise without replacing their core systems, has raised £19.5 million at a £195 million valuation.
items.why: Significant funding round for a prominent enterprise fintech serving traditional banks.

items.title: Starling build agentic fincrime investigator that takes 17 seconds
items.summary: Starling has deployed an agentic financial crime investigator that the UK digital bank says can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds.
items.why: Major deployment of autonomous AI agents for financial crime investigations in banking.

items.title: Checkout.com expands into in-person payments
items.summary: Checkout.com, a leading global payments company, today announced its expansion into in-person payments, in response to significant demand from enterprise merchants seeking the performance and resilience of its online acquiring platform in stores.
items.why: Major online payment player expanding into physical point-of-sale infrastructure.

items.title: Evervault launches Browser Tokens, enabling secure agentic payments
items.summary: Evervault today announced the launch of Browser Tokens at Money20/20, giving developers building agentic commerce products a secure way for AI agents and browser automations to make purchases, log in to accounts and complete sensitive online workflows without exposing payment cards, passwords or personal data to the agent or browser provider.
items.why: New product launch enabling AI agent autonomous payment workflows.

items.title: Standard Chartered to acquire Zodia Custody
items.summary: UK bank and global custodian Standard Chartered is set to acquire digital assets service provider Zodia Custody.
items.why: Major acquisition of a digital asset custodian by a global custodian bank.

items.title: India's largest bank hit by cyberattack
items.summary: State Bank of India (SBI), the country's largest lending institution by assets, has launched an internal investigation after an alleged cyberattack exposed user's personal information.
items.why: Major cyberattack exposing customer data at India's largest bank.

items.title: Singapore's Sea plans IPO for fintech arm Monee
items.summary: Singapore-based conglomerate is planng to float its fintech arm, Monee, on the Singapore Stock Exchange (SGX)
items.why: Sea's planned IPO for its fintech arm is a major market listing move.

items.title: New Victorian laws reveal auction reserves, so buyers stop wasting weekends
items.summary: The real estate industry says new laws targeting agents underquoting a house price are well-intentioned but poorly designed.
items.why: New state consumer housing finance legislation regulating property auction reserves and underquoting.

items.title: Epstein bill would push regulators to disclose bank probes
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/u4mu2wwDbZgNpBbpyv_AdKarBIU1cRoYbW0c7iuGOCM/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMjYwMDg4OTc4LmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p Bank executives could face industry bans, fines and criminal referrals under legislation proposed by Sen. Elizabeth Warren, D-MA. /p
items.why: Proposed legislation forcing bank regulators to disclose confidential probes.

items.title: UK Businesses File £700m CAT Claim over Visa and Mastercard EEA Fees
items.summary: A Competition Appeal Tribunal claim alleges the card networks raised UK-EEA interchange fees five-fold after Brexit, costing businesses up to £200m a year. The post UK Businesses File £700m CAT Claim over Visa and Mastercard EEA Fees appeared first on The Fintech Times .
items.why: Major £700m antitrust claim filed against card networks over cross-border interchange fees.

items.title: NYDFS fines Swedish bank SEB $33M over AML issues
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/oJJRGJ8I24lnNSoZ9RfRv4pBHj8Zc4OvE92AK-rBmh0/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMTk5MDk0MjIyLmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p Anti-money laundering program deficiencies at Stockholm-based Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken came to light following the 2016 Panama Papers leak that ensnared hundreds of banks. /p
items.why: Regulatory enforcement action fining major Swedish bank $33m for AML compliance failures.

items.title: Assistant treasurer knew about ATO's credit card ban plans months ago
items.summary: Assistant Treasurer Daniel Mulino concedes the government knew the Australian Taxation Office was considering banning credit card payments in July, months before the decision was made public.
items.why: Reveals government timeline and knowledge regarding ATO policy to ban credit card tax payments.

items.title: SBI, Mesh Connect and Money Forward Form Digital-Asset JV in Japan
items.summary: The three firms have agreed to establish Mesh SBI Money Forward Network KK to build API-connected digital asset payment infrastructure in Japan. The post SBI, Mesh Connect and Money Forward Form Digital-Asset JV in Japan appeared first on The Fintech Times .
items.why: Major financial firms establish a new joint venture for API-connected digital asset payment infrastructure.

items.title: Suncorp borrower's mortgage payments could spike amid transfer to ANZ
items.summary: Suncorp mortgage borrowers have received an alarming email informing them ANZ's takeover could see their minimum monthly mortgage repayments increase by hundreds of dollars.
items.why: ANZ takeover unexpectedly causes significant mortgage repayment increases for Suncorp retail borrowers.

items.title: Judge finds Aboriginal protection order on goldmine 'fundamentally flawed'
items.summary: The Federal Court identifies fundamental flaws in the process involved in granting Aboriginal protection to part of a goldmine site in New South Wales.
items.why: Federal Court ruling sets aside regulatory heritage protection order on major goldmine project.

items.title: NAB to slash up to 2,500 jobs in massive restructure
items.summary: National Australia Bank says it will cut about 6 per cent of its workforce by mid-2027, as it overhauls its operating model.
items.why: Major Australian bank announces unexpected mass redundancies and operational restructuring.

items.title: RBA deputy warns inflation outlook 'materially worse' as next decision looms
items.summary: As markets put the chance of a rate hike in November at 42 per cent, Reserve Bank deputy governor Andrew Hauser warns of a "central banker's nightmare".
items.why: Hawkish central bank warning signaling worsening inflation and potential rate hike.

items.title: Tech giant shares plunge 40pc after delays to Melbourne data centre
items.summary: Community opposition to one of Victoria's largest data centres has seen the value of shares in NextDC plummet.
items.why: Unexpected massive market sell-off with 40% share price collapse for major ASX tech firm.
